ACTION WORDS · CLASS 49 · AGES 4–5 · CARD 11 OF 24

Turn, Spin, Stop, Start & Wait

Every game you play uses this card: TURN when the music says so, SPIN until the room giggles, STOP when the whistle blows, START on the magic word, and WAIT while it gets to your turn. Musical chairs, red-light-green-light, board games — this card runs them all.

The card says

“TURN · SPIN · STOP · START · WAIT” — printed on the card.

Try it today

Play red light, green light with card words: start on green, stop on red, spin on yellow, turn on blue, and wait your turn in line. Five words, one game, everybody plays.

Keep going

Turn, Spin, Stop, Start & Wait is one of the twenty-four cards in Class 49 · Action Words — the class page holds the whole set, one shelf per part of the day. Next up: Blow, Wave, Shake, Stretch & Bend.
